requirements: The homepage should have a modern, minimal aesthetic with a clean, spacious, and fully responsive layout. The color tone should be neutral with subtle shadows that match a minimalist fashion brand feel. The page should be easy to navigate and provide a clear call-to-action for users to explore the store.

files.name: - index.html   - shop.html   - cart.html   - styles.css   - script.js   - products.json
files.path: output/clothing-store-homepage/- index.html   - shop.html   - cart.html   - styles.css   - script.js   - products.json

shared_components: Header with search bar (#search-input) and cart section (#cart-count, #cart-subtotal)
Footer with company info, navigation links, and contact information

tasks.constraints: The products.json file should be loaded from the SHARED_ASSETS directory and should contain a list of products with their respective categories, prices, and descriptions. The file should be used by the script.js file to display products on the shop page.

The index.html file should use the Header and Footer shared components and should have a modern, minimal aesthetic with a clean, spacious, and fully responsive layout. The color tone should be neutral with subtle shadows that match a minimalist fashion brand feel. The page should be easy to navigate and provide a clear call-to-action for users to explore the store.

The shop.html file should use the Header and Footer shared components and should display a list of products with filters and sorting options. The page should be easy to navigate and provide a clear call-to-action for users to add products to their cart.

The cart.html file should use the Header and Footer shared components and should display a list of products in the user's cart with options to update quantity and remove products. The page should be easy to navigate and provide a clear call-to-action for users to checkout.

The stylesheet should define a modern, minimal aesthetic with a clean, spacious, and fully responsive layout. The color tone should be neutral with subtle shadows that match a minimalist fashion brand feel.
The script should load products from the products.json file and display them on the shop page. The script should also handle filtering and sorting of products.
